corrections.said: The effect of a short way round ends between loop² 19 and 21: a loop of 21 costs nothing
corrections.now: In the living state a face is less dense for every loop round it, by a term that falls smoothly with the loop's length and does not end (f(21) is 45σ from zero); what ends at 21 is what the lifetimes can resolve, against faces that themselves carry loops of 21 to 31
corrections.by: the study of the living state (research/wraplocal) and the lead's own re-measurement with separate code
words: the effect does not end at 21
corrections.quote: Since (WL4, WL5): the effect does not end at 21; in the living state the deficit falls smoothly, and what ends there is the lifetimes' resolution, against a baseline of faces that themselves carry loops of 21–31.

corrections.said: Whether a gap is forgotten or fatal is a property of the end alone
corrections.now: True of holes only: a second one-cell gap (K0) sorts the 741 ends four ways, and 503 of them tell the two kinds apart by dying of one
corrections.by: a reviewer with independent code (research/audit/REVIEW-signals-5.md), and the lead's oracle run of every end
corrections.quote: "Forgotten or fatal is a property of the end alone" holds for holes only.
corrections.src: NB 2026-11-15, the fifth signals push reviewed

audits.line: Own SAT encoding and two more solvers: still no listener within bounds; the census of 741 ends recounted; every one-unit change of a rake; a second kind of gap; the echo.
